newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices fall on poor demand, new crops.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices fall on poor demand, new crops.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell by seven rupees to 1,130/1,131 rupees per quintal on sluggish demand and rising new crop arrivals, dealers said.

Castorseed arrivals from Gujarat region rose on Monday to 15-17,000 bags (75 kg each). "Sentiments remained subdued but some operators were expecting a modest recovery from the lower level as technically the market is oversold," one dealer said.

Groundnut oil fell to 342/343 rupees from 344/345 rupees on higher new crop arrivals of about 140-150 tonnes coupled with sluggish consumer and retail buying. In Rajkot spot oil was firm at 525/530 rupees per 15 kg.
